add_typelib(std_ole_v2.idl)
spec2def(stdole2.tlb stdole2.tlb.spec)

# stdole2.tlb is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/stdole2_tlb-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(stdole2.tlb stdole2_tlb-cargo stdole2.tlb
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/std_ole_v2.tlb)
add_dependencies(stdole2.tlb_cargo xdk)
